title: salix glandulosa
intro: Salix glandulosa, commonly known as glandular willow, is a species of willow tree native to China. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving fever, and treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Salix glandulosa include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicylic acid. The health benefits of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, and it has been used to treat various conditions including arthritis and rheumatism.
